data.name: Jotish
data.gender_notes: Jotish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jotish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jot' which means 'Knowledge' and 'Is' which means 'He'. This name is given to a boy who is considered to be a source of wisdom and knowledge. Jotish is believed to have a deep understanding of the world and a strong desire to learn and explore new things. The name Jotish carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Wise” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Jotish usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jotish is a spiritual name that represents the seeker of knowledge and wisdom. It is a name for those who are on a spiritual journey to discover the truth of the universe and the inner workings of their own mind and soul.
data.etymology: Jotish belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jotish total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jotish holds great significance in Hindu culture as it reflects the value placed on knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, the gods and goddesses are often depicted as possessing vast amounts of knowledge and being the source of all wisdom. Jotish, as a name, inspires the bearer to strive for knowledge and wisdom, and to seek wisdom in all aspects of life, thereby contributing to the intellectual growth of the community. It is also believed that people with the name Jotish possess great intellectual abilities and are natural problem solvers.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Jotish signifies the inner light or illumination that exists within each individual. It is a reminder that we all have the capacity to gain knowledge, wisdom and understanding, not just through external sources, but through our inner consciousness and connection to the divine. The name Jotish is also believed to bring blessings of knowledge, understanding, and enlightenment. It is a name that inspires self-discovery, introspection, and a deep connection to the higher self.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jotish: One who is enlightened by the wisdom of the stars and celestial bodies, a Jyotish is a Hindu astrologer who uses this cosmic knowledge to guide and enlighten others. The divine light within, represented by the stars, illuminates the path to wisdom and understanding.
